about: Verification of the criticism look-back by a skeptic who did none of the work. (1) His messages from every session were read start to end (672 after repeats removed) against criticisms.json; nine instances were added, eight missed and one moved to a better rule, all under existing rules. (2) Every rule marked written 'no', 'partly' or 'conflicts', and every check marked 'none', was searched again in CLAUDE.md, docs/design-system.md, docs/copy.md, every test file and research/audit/tools. Six claims were corrected; the rest hold, including the three conflicts. (3) Each of the 63 site breaks of the three sweeps was opened on the live site at its width (1440x900 or 390x844 with touch, a goal saved on the device for held pages), by its text and a screenshot, and the open issues were read. Confirmed breaks are below (four sweep entries folded into another as the same symptom); a break that was not there, is a technicality, is covered by an open issue or was unsure is under refuted. Scripts and shots used: the scratchpad; three shots kept in shots/verify-*.

rules.rule: Inside one chart, parts or series that a legend tells apart have colours too alike (one hue, near neighbours or all grey), so they cannot be told apart.

Against it, docs/design-system.md 6.5 (comparison chart, held for review): "Why one hue in steps rather than four hues: the ranking is ordinal" (teal-200, teal-400, teal-600 told apart by a legend).

Add it to kit/guards.test.ts with the palette code moved from research/specs into site/app/lib. A second leg in a Playwright script: read the computed fill of every legend swatch in a rendered chart and run the same pairs, so a colour set inline is caught too.
